The ladder code for 94 is already in the game (v34.13 to v34.16), but the re-measure of coord-07's A-t4 and C-t4 has not run. I made no change this run.

I confirmed the shipped code in `dark_raiders.html`, around lines 35218 to 35279 (`DRS`, `GFXQ`, `gfxqCan`, `drsTick`). I did not re-check it against the six steps this run; earlier runs did, and the empty bloom and lamp-shadow rungs are off the ladder (`gfxqCan` returns false for them).

The A-t4 and C-t4 re-measure is blocked because `runA.sh`, `runC.sh` and the Chrome scripts are not in a form my command list allows. `notes/coord-07/94-ladder-after` does not exist yet, and I did not invent numbers. The old numbers are:

| Run | p50 | p95 |
|---|---|---|
| A-t4 | 40.8 ms | 50.1 ms |
| C-t4, player 1 | 148.5 ms | 187.1 ms |
| C-t4, player 2 | 146.7 ms | 217.6 ms |

The critic scored the firefight pictures at 2 to 3, not 4. Earlier runs judged its fixes to be about the whole HUD and to run against his later orders (compact corner, larger health bar), so they are not ladder defects.

Watch line for his next play: a raid that turns softer or loses sparks while nothing is happening, or sparks or haze that come and go. The first 20 seconds of each raid should look like the rest.

I logged this run in `tools/handoff/console/notes/94-ladder-sheds-sooner.md`.

TASK PARTIAL: only the A-t4 / C-t4 re-measure remains, and it needs `notes/coord-07/runA.sh` and `runC.sh` run on a lane's own port by someone with permission to run them.
